analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]

· Position relative to SMA100 ($1.30)/SMA200 ($1.23): below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (2.0%) + current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (25.7→28.1) + entered oversold territory, attempting to exit.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0074→0.0025) + improving, but no bearish reversal signal yet confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $0.83) + band width at 33.28% indicating sustained volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.89) + close to 52-week low of $0.87, forming a strong support zone.
· Swing resistance ($1.13) + potential for mid-term trend reversal upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (no Higher Low formed, no Lower High formed) → sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.67x) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to lack of clear directional bias.
